architecture: Observation-only motion planner with a frozen continuous latent-conditioned feedback controller

state_fields: active-gate-relative position expressed in current body frame (3)
first two columns of gate-to-body rotation R_BG (6)
inference.gate_fields: Four ordered corner vectors from current drone origin expressed in current FLU body frame, plus valid mask

transformer.block: AdaRMSNorm/SwiGLU, causal attention across token order; not temporal history

controller.activation: SiLU hidden; bounded collective/body-rate command mapping

training_stages.name: Action-conditioned world-model pretraining
training_stages.description: Closed-loop flight corpus, causal action alignment, 32-tick autoregressive latent rollouts, physically scaled reconstruction/increment losses with rotation handling; no value head in the selected physical model.

training_stages.name: Privileged motion-codec/controller PPO
training_stages.description: MLP encoder sees current ego49 plus eight future 15D motion samples and eight masks (177D); continuous64 code conditions current-state feedback MLP. Expert motions supply tracking targets and reference-phase resets; controller learns through PPO.
training_stages.future_features: Relative position3, velocity3, rotation6, angular velocity3 in one current-body anchor frame

training_stages.name: JEPA-style latent alignment
training_stages.description: Freeze privileged motion encoder as stopped-gradient target; observation-only pretrained Transformer plus MLP predicts the same64D coordinates. Projector-only warmup precedes joint backbone updates.

training_stages.name: Differentiable physical-window warmup
training_stages.description: Frozen controller; update planner/projector through achieved-state multistep trajectory loss. Teacher forcing occurs only at expert segment initialization. Refresh observations from own achieved state at every subsequent tick.

training_stages.name: Pure racing PPO
training_stages.description: No expert future enters policy. Optimize planner/backbone/projector and action exploration; decoder/interface stay frozen. Green-style progress/gate/collision reward, shared raw critic, minibatch PPO, two/four/full-gate curriculum, evidence-driven course sampling. Latest continuation retains50percent original seed lanes alongside gentle qualified online variants; no dynamics/JEPA auxiliary during this final stage.
